cohort: Neonates with 32-36 weeks gestational age from multi-center hospitals in Lhokseumawe, Aceh, Indonesia.
finding: No significant association was found between FOXP2 gene polymorphisms (genotypes or alleles) and the duration of orogastric tube use in preterm neonates.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was significantly associated with the duration of orogastric tube use in preterm neonates.
